findings.claim: Starbucks 與 Boyu Capital 的中國合資案（Boyu 取得中國零售營運 60% 權益，估值約 40 億美元）2025-11 宣布，2026-04 完成交割；Starbucks 保留 40% 並授權品牌。
findings.source: New Straits Times 轉載 Reuters：Starbucks closes China deal with Boyu

findings.claim: 2026-09-22 董事會核准「Back to Starbucks」進一步行動：關閉北美約 1% 門市，重組費用約 3 億美元（約 2 億現金、1 億非現金）；FY2026 淨新開店指引由 600–650 降至約 440。
findings.excerpt: Of the approximately $300 million of restructuring charges to be incurred, the Company anticipates that approximately $200 million will be cash charges primarily related to lease exit costs and employee separation benefits.

findings.claim: 2026-05-13 董事會核准重組計畫：精簡國內外支援組織與非零售設施，並降低 Reserve／Roastery 門市營運複雜度。
findings.excerpt: Under the approved restructuring plan, the Company plans to capture cost savings by further streamlining its domestic and international support organization and non-retail facilities.

findings.claim: 2024 年提起的證券集體訴訟（W.D. Wash.，class period 2023-11-02 至 2024-04-30，因 2024-04-30 下修財測股價單日跌逾15%）仍為主要訴訟；2026-01 另有律所宣布對董事／管理層受託責任的衍生訴訟調查。搜尋未見 2026 年和解或判決消息，現況未確認。
